## HIGH IMPACT

No high-severity breaking changes are identified in this diff. No CSS custom properties were renamed or removed, no web component element names targeted by ha-lcars were changed, and no shadow DOM structure changes affecting existing card-mod selectors were detected.

---

## MEDIUM IMPACT

### Component: `ha-icon-button-group` / `ha-icon-button-toggle`

**What changed:** `ha-icon-button-group` was completely refactored from a trivial `<slot></slot>` wrapper into a stateful component with an animated sliding "thumb" indicator (`src/components/ha-icon-button-group.ts`, +108 lines). Simultaneously, `ha-icon-button-toggle` introduced a new CSS custom property `--ha-icon-button-toggle-thumb-opacity` that defaults to `1` but is set to `0` (via `ha-icon-button-group` zeroing it) when buttons are inside the group so the group's sliding thumb draws the selection circle instead (`src/components/ha-icon-button-toggle.ts`).

**What ha-lcars rules are affected:** ha-lcars does not currently inject any card-mod CSS specifically targeting `ha-icon-button-group` or `ha-icon-button-toggle`. However, wherever these components appear in the UI (e.g., media player controls, automation editors, the new icon button group animation added in PR #53597), the new sliding thumb will render using HA's default colors rather than any LCARS palette colors. The thumb is drawn as a `::before` pseudo-element on an internal `<div class="thumb">` inside the new `ha-icon-button-group` shadow DOM, colored by HA's internal tokens (likely `--ha-color-primary-*` or similar surface tokens).

**Suggested fix:** If the sliding thumb color appears out of place against LCARS card backgrounds, add a targeted card-mod rule. The new variable `--ha-icon-button-toggle-thumb-opacity` can be used to suppress the per-button circle entirely if preferred:

```css
/* Suppress individual toggle circles in favor of group thumb, or recolor thumb */
ha-icon-button-group {
  --ha-icon-button-toggle-thumb-opacity: 0; /* already done by the group itself */
}
```

To recolor the sliding thumb to an LCARS color, target the group's shadow DOM. The thumb appears to be a `div.thumb` inside `ha-icon-button-group`'s shadow root, styled with a `background-color` set inline via `styleMap`. This background is not currently exposed as a CSS custom property, so it cannot be overridden via a variable alone. Monitor whether HA exposes a `--ha-icon-button-group-thumb-color` variable in a subsequent release. For now, no card-mod injection can reach it without a `$` shadow-piercing selector in card-mod-root or equivalent.

---

### Component: `ha-button`

**What changed:** The `ha-button` component gained an `outlined` appearance variant and new `xs`-size styles (padding, border-radius, font-size). The JSDoc attribute comment corrects `"outlined"` as a valid `appearance` value (`src/components/ha-button.ts`, diff line: `@attr {("accent"|"filled"|"outlined"|"plain")} appearance`).

**What ha-lcars rules are affected:** ha-lcars styles `ha-button` indirectly through variables like `--ha-ripple-color`, `--ha-ripple-pressed-opacity`, and `--ha-ripple-hover-opacity` set on button-class cards. The new `outlined` appearance renders with `box-shadow: var(--ha-button-box-shadow)` for its border. ha-lcars sets `mdc-button-outline-color: transparent` in `&base` which affects the MDC-era outline; this variable does **not** control the new `ha-button` outlined variant's box-shadow border. As a result, `outlined` ha-buttons may show a default HA border color rather than an LCARS-appropriate one.

**Suggested fix:** Add `--ha-button-box-shadow` to ha-lcars's base variable block if outlined buttons appear in places the theme needs to control. The variable is already referenced in `ha-button.ts`'s new CSS block. For now, set it in `&base` or in card-mod context as needed:

```yaml
# In &base or card-mod card CSS:
ha-button-box-shadow: "none"   # or: "0 0 0 1px var(--lcars-card-top-color)"
```

---

### Component: `ha-button-toggle-group`

**What changed:** A `disabled` boolean property was added to `ha-button-toggle-group`, which propagates `.disabled` to each child button (`src/components/ha-button-toggle-group.ts`). When the group is disabled, all contained `ha-button` elements will receive `disabled` styling from HA's default token set.

**What ha-lcars rules are affected:** ha-lcars sets `disabled-text-color: var(--lcars-graphite)` in `&base`. Disabled buttons in a toggle group will inherit this text color. However, the disabled button background color is controlled by HA's internal tokens (likely `--ha-color-fill-primary-quiet-resting` or equivalent), which ha-lcars does not currently map to an LCARS color. Disabled toggle group buttons may appear with a non-LCARS background.

**Suggested fix:** If disabled toggle groups are visually jarring, extend the card-mod CSS to set disabled button backgrounds. No immediate action is required if disabled states are rare in LCARS dashboards. Monitor appearance in the UI.

---

## LOW IMPACT

### Component: `ha-icon` — MQTT logo addition

**What changed:** A custom MQTT icon provider was added to `ha-icon`'s `CUSTOM_ICONS` registry (`src/components/ha-icon.ts`). The string `"mqtt"` now resolves to a custom SVG logo rather than an MDI fallback.

**ha-lcars impact:** No existing ha-lcars CSS targets this icon specifically. MQTT icons displayed in entity rows, device pages, or integration lists will now render as the MQTT logo SVG. The icon inherits `color` from its context (controlled by `--state-icon-color` or `--lcars-card-button-text` in row/button contexts via ha-lcars). No fix needed — the icon will automatically receive LCARS-themed coloring from inherited CSS custom properties.

---

### Component: `ha-sidebar` — internal type rename

**What changed:** `ActionHandlerDetail` import was renamed to `ActionHandlerEvent` in `ha-sidebar.ts`. This is a TypeScript type change only with no runtime or DOM impact.

**ha-lcars impact:** None. ha-lcars targets `ha-sidebar` via `card-mod-sidebar-yaml` using element selectors and class names, none of which are affected by this internal type rename. No fix needed.

---

### Component: New layout components (`ha-grouped-list`, `ha-filter-pane-chip`)

**What changed:** Two new reusable components were added: `ha-grouped-list` (PR #53618) and `ha-filter-pane-chip` (PR #53682). These appear in updated filter panes, the history/activity redesign, and the target picker. The filter pane also now uses a bottom sheet in narrow mode (PR #53684).

**ha-lcars impact:** ha-lcars does not currently inject CSS targeting `ha-grouped-list` or `ha-filter-pane-chip` by name. These components will render using HA's default color tokens. The filter pane bottom sheet in narrow mode will use `--ha-color-surface-default` and related tokens. ha-lcars's `card-mod-config-yaml` variables (`--lcars-settings-card-color`, `--lcars-primary-text`) may or may not cascade into these new components depending on shadow DOM depth. No fix needed immediately, but theme authors may wish to add targeted rules if the filter pane appearance is important.

---

### Component: Date picker navigation arrows now themeable

**What changed:** Date picker navigation arrows were made themeable (PR #53639, "Make date picker navigation arrows themeable"). New CSS custom properties are likely exposed on the date picker component for arrow colors.

**ha-lcars impact:** ha-lcars does not currently style date picker arrows. The new variables (specific names not visible in the provided diff) could be set to LCARS palette colors. No fix needed, but optionally add `--ha-date-picker-arrow-color` (or equivalent, pending variable name confirmation from source) mapped to `var(--lcars-ui-tertiary)` or `var(--lcars-primary-text)` for consistency. Monitor the actual variable name in a subsequent diff.

---

### Component: Map card scale ruler

**What changed:** A scale ruler was added to the map card (PR #53494). This is a new visual element rendered inside `hui-map-card`'s shadow DOM with its own default styling.

**ha-lcars impact:** ha-lcars does not currently inject CSS into `hui-map-card`. The scale ruler will render with HA defaults (likely dark text on a light background or vice versa). In dark LCARS themes with a black `lcars-background-color`, the ruler may be low-contrast. No fix required, but optionally add a card-mod rule targeting the scale ruler element inside `hui-map-card $` if contrast is insufficient.
